other.penalty:
Summary : Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 154 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (increased limit on magistrates' power of imprisonment), sentencing shall have the effect as if the reference to fifty one weeks were a reference to six months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
